category: Google Drive sharing front end (Indian DDL ecosystem), DriveSeed template twin

free_tier.stated: "UNLIMITED - No quota limit. No annoying waiting times, Share & Download as many files as you want." Free, no account needed to download.
free_tier.notes: Same sentence, same layout and same claim as DriveSeed v5.1; this instance reports v4.6.

retention.stated: Not stated; links resolve to a Google Drive id whose life decides theirs.

egress.terms: One-click download from the site, no wait. No price, allowance or meter printed.

interface_detail: Web only. Google OAuth sign-in, TeamDrive and shared-drive browsing, short-link creation. No first-party API was found; third-party bypass scripts exist for the family.
tooling: Bypass scripts (for example gdflix.py in Bypass-Scripts, keyed to new.gdflix.ink) are the practical client. No SDK, no rclone backend.
chaining: Interchangeable with DriveSeed at the bottom of the same chain: the index site can post either, and both end at a Google Drive object. Running two of them gives the operator two hosts for one Drive, which is the resilience the chain relies on.
limits_note: No site-side counter is published. The only meaningful throttle is the one Drive applies, documented by the twin service's changelog as '403: User Rate Limit Exceeded'.
binding_note: At 1 TiB a month the bytes come from Google and Google shapes them; GDFlix adds nothing that could bind first.

identity_cost.detail: Downloaders need no account. A publisher needs a Google account to grant the app Drive access; the sign-in is the same OAuth flow as DriveSeed.

reliability_note: An instance of a copied template: three hosts were tried today and only gdflix.net answered a site (gdflix.pro was refused, and the live page itself redirects to new7.gdflix.io). Instances vanish and renumber; a link outlives the hostname that served it.
confidence_note: The live page was read and carries the same marketing as DriveSeed. The record is deliberately thin where the vendor is: no byte number exists to record. One measured download would move it.

evidence.proved: live GDFlix v4.6 at new7.gdflix.io with the 'UNLIMITED - No quota limit' claim, TeamDrive support and the share-link flow
gdflix.pro is listed with appdrive.in, driveapp.in, drivehub.in, drivesharer.in and driveseed as the same lookalike family, which is why this record does not treat any one hostname as the service
